Definition: Zicri, the name of twelve Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zicri — spelled Zichri on the People profiles — is a name carried by twelve Israelites, from the Kohathite of Exodus 6 to the priest of Abijah's course and the father of Amasiah, a mighty man under Jehoshaphat. The name means ‘memorable,’ and the men behind it range across the tribes and the centuries. Their full stories live on their People profiles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name that means ‘memorable’ fits the record: twelve men, one name, and God remembered every one of them.
